messages.author: c5d9cd963a17d60f
messages.subject: Error while reading Progenesis output
parts:
Hi all,

I have been trying to run MSstats on our Progenesis files.
Since our files are lack of spectral count, peptide sequences, modification etc columns, I assumed at the beginning that the script will not work.
And as expected we got an error

"Error in which(colnames(input) == "Raw.abundance"):(which(colnames(input) ==  :  argument of length 0" due to non-existing spectral count column.

For future we can export the data with all required columns but for time being we don't have this option. Therefore;

1- If I introduce these columns with fake values, what would happen? Or for which ones introducing fake values will have no effect on the outcome?
2- Is there are way to modify the code such that "accession","peptide count","unique peptides", "confidence score", "anova(p)", "max fold change", "highest mean condition",
"lowest mean condition", "description", "normalized abundance", "raw abundance" with corresponding runnames and condition columns would be enough?
Thank you very much for your effort and your help.

Best,
Canan

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Error while reading Progenesis output
parts:
First of all, there are small updated in v3.8.x from Bioconductor.

At least you need 'Sequence', 'Charge'  columns. For Sequence column, I recommend to used 'Accession', which will be protein id. For Charge column, I recommend just one unique value, such as 0 for all. 
At this moment, you need 'Spectral.count' columns. You don't need all. Just add one Spectral.count column at the end.

- Meena
